industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Omega Geracao S.A.
summary: Omega Geração S.A. generates and sells electricity from wind, hydro, and solar sources. It operates 15 renewable energy projects with an installed capacity of 426 megawatts, as well as 47 ventures with an installed capacity of 1,037.9 megawatts. The company was formerly known as Omega Energia Renovável S.A. Omega Geração S.A. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
